AGENTTOOLING / LOCAL BUILD PLANNING

From a build idea to a checked plan.

Synthetic component rules and a scripted model fixture. No live AI inference, electrical testing, firmware generation or CAD rendering. Nothing is sent to an external model.

Build result

Try: Plant moisture monitor; Climate monitor with display; Indicator light. Other capabilities may be unsupported.

Revise a supported plan

Downloaded OpenSCAD source is an illustrative enclosure. Fit, connector access, tolerances and manufacturability have not been physically verified.
